rows.note: This is the direct, all-purpose word for someone whose job is selling goods, especially in a shop.

example.english: I asked a salesperson to come over and check whether they had my size.
example.traditional: 我叫個售貨員過嚟，問吓有冇我嘅碼。
example.jyutping: ngo5 giu3 go3 sau6 fo3 jyun4 gwo3 lai4 man6 haa2 jau5 mou5 ngo5 ge3 maa5

rows.note: Use this for a shop employee when the retail-shop context makes it clear that the person is serving or selling to customers.

example.english: The salesperson at this bookstore knows the new books well and gives very suitable recommendations.
example.traditional: 呢間書店嘅店員好熟啲新書，介紹得好貼題。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 syu1 dim3 ge3 dim3 jyun4 hou2 suk6 di1 san1 syu1 gaai3 siu6 dak1 hou2 tip3 tai4
